mainEntity.name: How can I use AI workflow automation to create and sell a digital product without producing generic junk?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Treat a digital product workflow as a production pipeline, not a button that creates a finished product. AI can support audience research, outlines, lessons, slides, scripts, videos, supporting materials, sales copy, and launch planning, while the creator checks accuracy, usefulness, originality, and fit.

## Context
Run My AI Business includes course-building, presentation, lesson-script, video, and launch examples. These assistants can support different stages, but the product still needs a coherent promise and meaningful human review.

## Key factors
- Audience need and learning objective
- Accuracy and completeness of the material
- Consistent structure and voice
- Delivery, checkout, and support requirements

## Practical guidance
Create a product brief before requesting drafts. Review every lesson or asset against the brief, test the customer experience, and avoid launching until delivery and follow-up steps work as intended.

The educational resources help creators connect development with selling and ongoing support.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use AI for research, outlines, lesson drafts, scripts, sales materials, and launch planning—but anchor every step to a defined audience problem and product promise. Review accuracy, usefulness, originality, delivery, and customer experience before release.
